overview.text: Today's key developments span commercial restrictions, infrastructure security, application architecture, and emerging threats. Anthropic has blocked users for activities touching the training of larger models, while separately filing its S-1 to prepare for its IPO. In development tooling, ChatGPT and Codex usage limits are now merging, and Parameter Labs detailed an exploit involving ChatGPT's implementation of HTML previews. Meanwhile, researchers demonstrated a novel side-channel attack capable of leaking secrets from air-gap computers by spelling radio signals from RAM. Open source releases introduce new capabilities for builders, including the persona-ai-sdk for TypeScript featuring durable character memory, a bitemporal AI memory system called graphmemory combining Neo4j, PostgreSQL, and Redis, and cheap-ag for scaling Claude usage. Finally, discussions continue around communicating extreme AI risks to senior policymakers in India and analyzing the performance costs associated with JavaScript frameworks.
